method: Direct build, deterministic calculation checks and live browser verification; no separate testing agent used for this change

passed: Deterministic repeatability
Each of six interaction vectors has unit weight
Combined scores are finite, non-negative and normalised
Exactly three distinct strongest signals
Answers produce different signal combinations
Three unique recommendations restricted to the other four active careers
Incomplete answers rejected
No raw recommendation strength returned for presentation

full_clickable_flows.sequence: Home / directory search → existing career overview → full roadmap → salary → Reality Check intro → all six experiences → completion → See My Results → personalised results → recommended career overview → browser Back → LinkedIn
passed: Overview contains neither salary nor Reality Check and ends at full-roadmap CTA
Roadmap contains six milestones followed immediately by salary and Reality Check CTA
Roadmap expansion and selected-career assessment links work
All six existing experiences remain interactive and preserve career-specific wording
See My Results now opens the selected career's dedicated results URL
Results show correct header, three choice-derived signals, career interpretation and three considerations from existing career content
Three career suggestion links point to existing overview routes and exclude the selected career
Exactly one LinkedIn link exists, in the final results section; none on overview, roadmap or assessment
LinkedIn new-tab click verified for Nurse; all five URLs use their correct profession query
Results survive refresh and return correctly after opening a suggested career
Incomplete direct results URL redirects to the matching assessment, not a placeholder
No horizontal overflow on checked desktop/mobile overview and result screens
No browser runtime exceptions

external_scope: LinkedIn outgoing links and new-tab behavior verified; authenticated LinkedIn search content is controlled by LinkedIn.
